title: docs: clarify UI extension uninstall goes through Apps not Extensions tab
body:
The Extensions → Installed Uninstall button doesn't work for community extensions in Rancher 2.14 — the App object is auto-synthesized from the Helm secret rather than owned by Rancher's catalog system, so the catalog delete path fails silently.

Correct path: **☰ → Apps → Installed Apps (local cluster) → rancher-secrets-manager-ui → Delete**
